description: Curated, verified catalog of genuinely FREE learning resources (YouTube channels/playlists, MOOCs, interactive platforms, official docs, free books) powering the learning-resource-finder skill and Drona's recommendations.
note: Link-out only. Every resource is free or free-audit (audit-only is marked cost=free-audit). LearningOS is not affiliated with these platforms — recommend and link, never reproduce or pirate paywalled/copyrighted content (videos, transcripts, books). URLs verified on the 'updated' date; platforms move, so verify a link before relying on it.
